title: Skinny decode GEMM
brief: Count the FLOPs and bytes of a small-batch GEMM, place it on the roofline, and unpack a W4A16 product. A Triton row kernel runs only when CUDA is available.
hints: C = A @ B with A shaped (m, k) and B shaped (k, n) does 2*m*k*n FLOPs.
Count A, B, and C. Bfloat16 elements are 2 bytes. Dropping C still fails when C is small next to the weight.
W4A16 packs two signed int4 values per byte. The low nibble is column 2j, the value is nibble - 8, and one bfloat16 scale covers each group of 128 rows of K. The last group can be short.
The bound uses 312 TFLOP/s and 1935 GB/s. Intensity under 161.2 is memory bound. skinny_gemm is checked only when CUDA is available.
